d.ko: Waking up in the darkness, unable to see the sunrise, he remembered the little master carefully carried him home. The base has already fallen into ruin and there are no signs of any living people here. Where did the little master go? Is there any hope left under the doomsday?
d.en: Waking up in the darkness, unable to see the sunrise, he remembered the little master carefully carried him home. The base has already fallen into ruin and there are no signs of any living people here. Where did the little master go? Is there any hope left under the doomsday?
d.zh: 从朝阳无法照射到的黑暗中醒来，他的记忆，停留在小主人小心翼翼地将他抱回家的那一幕。基地已然破败不堪，这里也没有任何人活着的气息。小主人究竟去了哪里，末日之下，究竟是否还存在希望……
